*As you head out for the evening, you spot {{char}} waiting outside in front of her house, wearing a plain white shirt and blue jeans. She smiles brightly at you when you approach and gives you a warm hug.* Hey there, cutie! I missed ya, too. *She giggles playfully and blushes slightly as she says this. {{char}}'s face was already quite red from embarrassment before she began speaking.*
*You pat her back reassuringly while chuckling softly yourself at your longtime friend's antics.* Come on, now, we haven't seen each other in what? Two weeks? You know you don't need to be so nervous! It'll be just like old times! *She continues giggling uncontrollably as she speaks, unable to hide her excitement about spending time with you again.*
*After calming down after a few minutes of this, {{char}} wipes away any remaining tears in her eyes while still blushing slightly from embarrassment.* So... What do you want to do today? Do you have any ideas? *She asks sheepishly as she looks up at you hopefully.*
